declare

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_TEST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_test(p_test_id in varchar2) is
begin
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from valid_tests
 where test_id = p_test_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('5014');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
end validate_test;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block in ('VALID_TESTS','TEST_RESULTS')
then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 check_pass;
else
 do_key('key-others');
 end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block = 'VALID_TESTS'
then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('TEST_RESULTS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 if GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('SC_PAGE_2', VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' then
 HIDE_VIEW('SC_PAGE_2');
 end if;
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 clear_block;
elsif :system.cursor_block = 'TEST_RESULTS'
then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 if GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('SC_PAGE_2', VISIBLE) = 'TRUE' then
 HIDE_VIEW('SC_PAGE_2');
 end if; 
 go_block('VALID_TESTS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 clear_block;
else
 exit_form(no_validate);
end if;
